subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does a security owner have private or reproducible evidence that current main can execute an ACP tool payload before its permission request resolves?
rationale: The claimed impact is an approval bypass, but the public report does not identify the alleged tokenizer or demonstrate the execution ordering; only a security owner can safely confirm whether undisclosed evidence establishes a real boundary failure.

options.title: Request concrete security proof
options.body: Ask the reporter for a private minimal payload, event trace, affected version, and demonstrated unauthorized action before selecting a repair boundary.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Close if the reporter cannot identify a current-main execution path after a reasonable security-triage window.

recommendation.title: Request concrete security proof
recommendation.body: Ask the reporter for a private minimal payload, event trace, affected version, and demonstrated unauthorized action before selecting a repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ACP authorization and semantic approval-class work makes @vincentkoc the strongest available routing candidate for validating this boundary.
